summary: The meeting refined the AI agent workflow for PR creation, addressed GitHub access issues, and discussed integrating tax/legal features and competitor insights into the product roadmap.

decisions.text: Agreed to rely on experts for high-risk tasks while allowing AI agents to handle low-risk experiments like ticket creation, error messaging updates, and PR generation; checkout and legal entity features will launch simultaneously despite payment tokenization dependencies, proceeding with independent workstreams if teams communicate properly.
